snippet.title: Mortal Shell II - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Mortal Shell II releases worldwide August 20 on PS5, Xbox and Steam. 

PRE-ORDER the Devout Edition now and get up to 72 hours Advanced Access: https://mortalshell.com/#where-to-buy

------------------------

Seek and possess. 

PRE-ORDERS NOW LIVE:
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10010058
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/mortal-shell-ii/9NS9TJV1JL86
Steam: https://s.team/a/4711740 

------------------------
Mortal Shell II is a standalone sequel action-RPG with adrenaline-charged, high-stakes combat. 

Possess warrior Shells, dethrone false gods, redeem a ravaged world. 

Play the Beta now on Steam: https://s.team/a/4711740
